evidence_events.notes: Reconciles the registry with legacy model-backed receipts. Coded self substitution is lossless on51 calibrated-domain prompts; zeroing the pointer collapses success; coded wrong-content effects agree with real activation edits; restricted natural-text replacement is lossless. Preserve limits: holdout-element generation fails in3/4 comparisons, full-vocabulary replacement costs.4513nats, and the later prospective H3+H7 screen is directionally asymmetric. Site-live only; no current-standard stable identification or compression adoption.

V1 was invalid only for a batch-shape self-replay error. V2 preserved rows and bars, replayed self exactly, and rejected both a selective multiplicative coherence gate and strict pointer invariance. All six backward donor-win flips under the late swap are baseline dominated; this opens a separate fixed-pointer baseline branch rather than a threshold or site rescue.

V1 was invalid solely because its hook could not count calls made through the custom forward. V2 retained the design and counted at the call boundary. Exact instruments and capability pass; no complete module passes both families. Attention8 is a frozen near carrier, not a promoted site.

The architecture-defined screen selected the smallest eligible group before length-six outcomes. The outcome-blind builder then froze every valid length-six window. The preselected group passed both families with no all-attention fallback. This is native-oracle mediation, not extraction.
Inclusion-exclusion was measured at final residual, RMS-normalized pre-softcap score, and post-softcap margins. A and M over-add; a large selective negative interaction calibrates AM.

V3 low-rank terminal is invalid, so no rank result is registered. The independent CPU audit proves the sole parent-gate failure is length-seven month projection; all exactness and capability checks pass.
